Specializes in matrimonial/family disputes, divorce, child custody, domestic violence, property/real estate (RERA), co-operative society matters, probate/wills, corporate documentation, and litigation.

Regularly appears before Bombay High Court, City Civil Court, Family Court, Criminal Court, Co-operative Court, Consumer Commission, RERA, and other authorities.

Offers services including legal consultation, mutual divorce settlements, Section 498A cases, maintenance proceedings, SARFAESI matters, partnership/company registration, trademarks, and civil/criminal cases. B.Com, LLB, Diploma in Personnel Management.
Established 1998.
